sentences.text: Gemma Shaw is the mother of Noah and Isla.
Noah is four months old and has had a feed.
Noah's four-month check is being conducted.
Noah weighs 6.8 kilos, which is on his growth line.
Isla is in reception at school and her teacher is Miss Patel.
Isla is reading little words at school.
Noah is currently on formula, consuming five ounces every three to four hours.
Gemma stopped breastfeeding at six weeks.
Noah has six to seven wet nappies per day.
Noah sleeps in a Moses basket in the mother's room.
Noah's sleep pattern is a five-hour stretch from about 11 p.m. to 4 a.m.
Isla told her mother that Uncle Ryan touched her private parts, which she calls her 'front bottom', when he babysits.
Isla said Ryan told her it was a secret and that she should not tell mummy.
Isla said this when she was in the bath on Sunday night.
Ryan is Liam's brother and babysits on Fridays when the mother is at work and Liam is on night shifts.
Ryan has been babysitting since September.
Gemma told Liam about what Isla said and Liam is upset, not believing it but also not fully denying it.
Gemma's sister Kelly said she heard Ryan was in trouble with the police years ago, but does not know what it was.
Kelly does not know what the incident with Ryan was, and she heard it from someone at work.
Gemma has not asked Isla any further questions about the incident.
Gemma has written down what Isla said, in her own words, with the date.
The health visitor, Rachel Moore, will share the information about Isla's disclosure with children's social care (Harbridge MASH) because of concerns for child safety.
The health visitor will share the disclosure with Harbridge MASH, the children's social care service.
Noah and Isla will not be in contact with Ryan until this situation is fully investigated.
Gemma will ensure Ryan does not have any time alone with Isla or Noah.
Gemma will not confront Ryan directly about the incident.
Liam wants to go to Ryan's house.
The health visitor advises that Liam should wait to go to Ryan's house to avoid making things harder for Isla.
Gemma will ask Liam to wait to go to Ryan's house.
Gemma will consider having her mother look after the children on Fridays instead of Ryan.
